seoTitle: Free Source Map Stack Trace Decoder and Position Lookup
metaDescription: Decode minified stack traces or line:column positions with a source map. Shows original file, line, column, name and source line. Local only.
intro: Reads a version 3 source map and translates minified positions into original ones. Paste a production stack trace (Chrome, Firefox or Safari style) or plain line:column pairs together with the .map file.
why:
A production error that says app.min.js:1:48213 is useless on its own. Source maps hold the answer, but reading them by hand means decoding base64 VLQ segments.

The decoder follows the source map specification and looks up each position in the map you paste. It applies the same map to every frame, so frames from other bundles will be wrong or unmapped. Nothing is uploaded, which matters because maps often contain your source code.
howTo: Paste the stack trace or line:column lines in the first box.
Paste the contents of the .map file in the second box.
Read the original position under each frame.
Untick source lines if you do not want code shown.
